title: avoid select except long lists
rule: Avoid select except long lists — selects hide content, are inconsistent across devices, and are hard for low digital literacy. Small lists (e.g. Australian state/territory) → radios / checkboxes / text. Long lists (e.g. country) may trade usability for compactness. Dual-cite GOV.UK / USWDS / NSW cutoffs; no house number.
pass_when: Short lists use radios/checkboxes/text; select is reserved for long lists (e.g. country). Dual-cite cutoff schools are not collapsed into a house N.
fail_when: A short list (e.g. state/territory) is a select; or a house numeric cutoff is invented as GOLD.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: A house “use select above N options”; NL `<select multiple>` ban as this single-select usage row.
